metadata.title: Dental Vendor Recovery Call Transcript
metadata.stakeholders: Elena Markovic; Lowry Beckett; Jaden Cole
metadata.demo_effect: Introduces recovery evidence and a revised schedule that should improve answer completeness.

payload.summary: The recovery call produced the first concrete improvement in the vendor path: partial sandbox access for named users on April 18 and a full environment target of April 25. The team still treats the program as caution, but the uncertainty is now bounded.

decisions.label: accept phased access
decisions.anchorText: The team will accept phased access beginning 4/18 instead of waiting for a perfect environment.

decisions.label: protect demo continuity
decisions.anchorText: Demo continuity will be protected by combining partial sandbox validation with mock services for uncovered paths.

decisions.label: circulate milestone confirmation
decisions.anchorText: Lowry will circulate the milestone confirmation the same day to close the primary action item.

warnings: The team still treats the program as caution, but the uncertainty is now bounded.
